# NEW 2026-11-22 v10.0 Worker 3: Playable Ming Dual-Track & Zheng He (oe_pmng_, Slot 79). Generated by gen_playable_ming.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Initialize core Ming Dual-Track state variables once on host.
oe_pmng_init_host = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmng_haijin_axis } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_haijin_axis value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmng_silver_fiscal } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_silver_fiscal value = 45 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmng_guanning } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_guanning value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmng_events_fired } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_events_fired value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_pmng_took_maritime_mantle } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_pmng_took_maritime_mantle value = 0 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_pmng_on value = 1 }
}

# Country scope. Bounded variable adjusters (zero overflow / underflow).
oe_pmng_add_haijin = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmng_haijin_axis } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_haijin_axis value = 0 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_pmng_haijin_axis add = $amt$ }
	clamp_variable = { name = oe_pmng_haijin_axis min = -100 max = 100 }
}

oe_pmng_add_silver = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmng_silver_fiscal } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_silver_fiscal value = 45 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_pmng_silver_fiscal add = $amt$ }
	clamp_variable = { name = oe_pmng_silver_fiscal min = 0 max = 100 }
}

oe_pmng_add_guanning = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmng_guanning } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_guanning value = 0 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_pmng_guanning add = $amt$ }
	clamp_variable = { name = oe_pmng_guanning min = 0 max = 4 }
}

# Country scope. O(1) monthly progression & chronological 4-Act event dispatcher on the Ming host.
oe_pmng_host_tick = {
	oe_pmng_init_host = yes

	# Sync silver fiscal health gently in January (O(1) once per year)
	if = {
		limit = { current_month = 1 }
		# v14.5 Annual safety net: ensure independent MNG is never ruled by a Mongol/Borjigin monarch
		if = {
			limit = {
				tag = MNG
				is_subject = no
				OR = {
					has_ruler = no
					ruler ?= {
						OR = {
							culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:mongolian_group }
							AND = { has_dynasty = yes dynasty ?= dynasty:borjigin_dynasty }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			create_character = {
				dynasty = dynasty:rtr_ming_zhu_dynasty
				age = 26
				culture = culture:jianghuai_culture
				religion = religion:sanjiao
				estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
				adm = 75
				dip = 70
				mil = 75
				save_scope_as = oe_pmng_zhu_restorer
			}
			set_new_ruler = scope:oe_pmng_zhu_restorer
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = oe_pmng_haijin_axis
				var:oe_pmng_haijin_axis >= 25
				NOT = { has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_cri2_silver_price_revolution }
			}
			oe_pmng_add_silver = { amt = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_cri2_silver_price_revolution
					has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_cri2_little_ice_age
				}
			}
			oe_pmng_add_silver = { amt = -2 }
		}
	}

	# Only dispatch one story event every 18 months so events pace naturally across 1355-1800
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmng_ev_cd } }
		# Act I (1355-1480) — v14.5: delay oe_pmng.1 until Red Turban Rebellions end or >= 1368
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmng_ev_1 }
				OR = {
					NOT = { is_situation_active = situation:red_turban_rebellions }
					current_year >= 1368
				}
				current_year <= 1395
				oe_pmng_holds_china_core = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_1 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmng.1
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmng_ev_2 }
				current_year >= 1369
				current_year <= 1415
				OR = { owns = location:fuliang owns = location:shangyuan }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_2 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmng.2
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmng_ev_3 }
				current_year >= 1402
				current_year <= 1435
				owns = location:dadu
				owns = location:shangyuan
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_3 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmng.3
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmng_ev_4 }
				current_year >= 1405
				current_year <= 1445
				has_non_rural_port = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_4 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmng.4
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmng_ev_5 }
				current_year >= 1420
				current_year <= 1495
				oe_pmng_holds_china_core = yes
				oe_pmng_has_roman_partner = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_5 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmng.5
		}
		# Act II (1445-1580)
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmng_ev_6 }
				current_year >= 1445
				current_year <= 1515
				oe_pmng_holds_china_core = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_6 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmng.6
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmng_ev_7 }
				current_year >= 1530
				current_year <= 1575
				OR = { owns = location:yinxian owns = location:jinjiang owns = location:hangzhou }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_7 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmng.7
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmng_ev_8 }
				current_year >= 1565
				current_year <= 1590
				has_non_rural_port = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_8 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmng.8
		}
		# Act III (1575-1660)
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmng_ev_9 }
				current_year >= 1575
				current_year <= 1605
				oe_pmng_holds_china_core = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_9 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmng.9
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmng_ev_10 }
				current_year >= 1590
				current_year <= 1625
				oe_pmng_holds_china_core = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_10 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmng.10
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmng_ev_11 }
				current_year >= 1610
				current_year <= 1645
				oe_pmng_holds_china_core = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_11 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmng.11
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmng_ev_12 }
				current_year >= 1620
				current_year <= 1655
				OR = { owns = location:ningyuan_jinzhou owns = location:funing owns = location:dadu }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_12 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmng.12
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmng_ev_13 }
				current_year >= 1630
				current_year <= 1665
				oe_pmng_in_late_ming_crisis = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_13 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmng.13
		}
		# Act IV (1660-1800)
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmng_ev_14 }
				current_year >= 1660
				current_year <= 1735
				has_non_rural_port = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_14 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmng.14
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmng_ev_15 }
				current_year >= 1730
				current_year <= 1800
				oe_pmng_holds_china_core = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_15 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmng.15
		}
		# Dynamic Southern Ming resilience (if Beijing falls while Ming holds the south)
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmng_ev_16 }
				oe_pmng_southern_ming_eligible = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ev_16 value = 1 }

# Any scope. Slot 79 master monthly entry point (called by oe_mainline_lock.txt OR oe_pmng_pulse.txt).
# Strictly O(1): immediately dormant when Great Yuan restores and neither MNG nor a Han MK leader exists.
oe_pmng_monthly = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_pmng_ran_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:MNG }
		c:MNG = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
				oe_pmng_host_tick = yes
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
			exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom.leader_country
			international_organization:middle_kingdom.leader_country = {
				oe_pmng_is_host = yes
			}
		}
		international_organization:middle_kingdom.leader_country = {
			oe_pmng_host_tick = yes
		}
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Readout & Dev Panel Page 78 Helpers (invoked by gen_dev_mod.py Page 78)
# ==============================================================================

# Country scope. Snapshots live Ming telemetry onto ROOT so oe_pmng.90 can be read from any country.
oe_pmng_snapshot_readout = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_rd_host value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_rd_haijin value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_rd_silver value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_rd_guanning value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_rd_events value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_pmng_took_maritime_mantle }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_rd_mantle value = global_var:oe_pmng_took_maritime_mantle }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_rd_mantle value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_manchu_pass }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_rd_sit_pass value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_rd_sit_pass value = 0 }
	}
	save_scope_as = oe_pmng_reader
	if = {
		limit = { oe_pmng_is_host = yes }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_rd_host value = 1 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pmng_haijin_axis } set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_rd_haijin value = var:oe_pmng_haijin_axis } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pmng_silver_fiscal } set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_rd_silver value = var:oe_pmng_silver_fiscal } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pmng_guanning } set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_rd_guanning value = var:oe_pmng_guanning } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pmng_events_fired } set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_rd_events value = var:oe_pmng_events_fired } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:MNG }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_rd_host value = 2 }
		c:MNG = {
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pmng_haijin_axis } scope:oe_pmng_reader = { set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_rd_haijin value = prev.var:oe_pmng_haijin_axis } } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pmng_silver_fiscal } scope:oe_pmng_reader = { set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_rd_silver value = prev.var:oe_pmng_silver_fiscal } } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pmng_guanning } scope:oe_pmng_reader = { set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_rd_guanning value = prev.var:oe_pmng_guanning } } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pmng_events_fired } scope:oe_pmng_reader = { set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_rd_events value = prev.var:oe_pmng_events_fired } } }
		}
	}
}

# Dev Macro 1 (Page 78): Launch Zheng He treasure voyages & claim the Maritime Silk mantle.
oe_pmng_dev_launch_zhenghe = {
	oe_pmng_init_host = yes
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_pmng_took_maritime_mantle value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_haijin_axis value = 50 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_dec_voyage_done value = 1 }
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmng_mod_treasure_voyages years = 25 mode = replace }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:MNG NOT = { tag = MNG } }
		c:MNG = {
			oe_pmng_init_host = yes
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_haijin_axis value = 50 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmng_mod_treasure_voyages years = 25 mode = replace }
		}
	}
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmng.4
}

# Dev Macro 2 (Page 78): Enact Single Whip Law & max Guanning Hongyi Cannon defense line.
oe_pmng_dev_single_whip_guanning = {
	oe_pmng_init_host = yes
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_silver_fiscal value = 80 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_guanning value = 4 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_dec_single_whip_done value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_yuanyang_ready value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_shenji_ready value = 1 }
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmng_mod_single_whip_law years = 35 mode = replace }
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmng_mod_guanning_bastion years = 25 mode = replace }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:MNG NOT = { tag = MNG } }
		c:MNG = {
			oe_pmng_init_host = yes
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_silver_fiscal value = 80 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmng_guanning value = 4 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmng_mod_single_whip_law years = 35 mode = replace }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmng_mod_guanning_bastion years = 25 mode = replace }
		}
	}
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmng.12
}
